title: Isle of saints
html_source:
A medieval term for Ireland.

This is a break from the barrage of thoughts in the previous paragraphs and is Stephen freely associating saint with saint; however he does pick up on a term which was used by others. He’s hearing an outside view of Ireland, a very subtle challenge to his self.

This short phrase effectively gives the reader a break from the inner monologue with this pointed thought, a single phrase, full stop. Then the inner monologue revs up again with a full-assault ‘you’.
